messages.text: My NerdQaxe++ arrived and it won't power on at all. Dead on arrival. What do I do?

Sorry — that's a bad start. A dead-on-arrival NerdQaxe++ goes through our RMA process.

Fill in the RMA intake form here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

You'll get a return label. Processing takes up to 10 days after the unit reaches our warehouse. One thing to flag up front: units that have been overclocked, modified, or opened up aren't covered.

What's the order number and the email on the order? I'll pull it up and flag this to the team.
